title: I want add a pdf file using api from front-end system into my erpnext

posts.name: Mohammed Anas
posts.cooked:
Hi everyone,

I’m on ERPNext v15 / Frappe v15.
I have a frontend system where a PDF file is generated. I want to send this PDF through API and have it uploaded into ERPNext, attached to a specific DocType with some data (for example, Sales Invoice or a custom DocType).

I’ve seen references to /api/method/upload_file and also examples of creating a File document with decode=1, but I’m not fully clear on the best approach.

  • Should I use the built-in /api/method/upload_file endpoint directly from the frontend (with multipart/form-data)?
  • Or should I create a custom whitelisted method that accepts a base64-encoded PDF and saves it?

What is the recommended way to do this? If anyone has a working example (frontend request + ERPNext side), that would be really helpful.

Thanks!
